webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: A signed JSON POST to your own endpoint whenever something happens here.

webhooks.endpointUrlHelp: https only (http://localhost is allowed for development).

payments.title: Payments
payments.descriptionCloud: Paid tickets settle straight into your own Stripe account.
payments.descriptionSelfHosted: This instance charges through the Stripe keys its operator configured.
payments.connectPrompt: Connect your Stripe account to sell paid tickets.
payments.configured: Stripe is configured. Paid tickets are charged on the instance's Stripe account with no platform fee.
payments.notConfigured: Stripe is not configured on this instance, so only free tickets can be sold. Set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY to enable payments.
payments.restrictedHelp: Complete the outstanding requirements in your Stripe dashboard to accept payments.
payments.unavailableHelp: We could not access this Stripe account. Try again, or reconnect the same account if access was removed.
payments.fees: Evnelo collects a 0.99% platform fee on paid tickets. Processing fees are charged by Stripe on your account, and your payouts are managed by Stripe.
payments.managerRequired: An organization owner or admin can connect the Stripe account.

results.success: Your Stripe account is connected. Check the account status below before selling tickets.
results.cancelled: The Stripe connection was cancelled. You can try again when you are ready.
results.invalid: This connection link expired or could not be verified. Start again from Payments settings.
results.failed: We could not complete the Stripe connection. Try again with the same Stripe account if this organization is already connected.
results.unconfigured: Stripe Connect is not configured on this platform. Contact the platform operator to enable paid tickets.

danger.title: Data and deletion
danger.description: Download everything this organization owns as JSON — events, orders, attendees, check-ins, settings, no secrets. Deleting the organization cancels its events, revokes every ticket, erases all attendee personal data and disables API keys and webhooks. It cannot be undone.
danger.ownerOnly: Only the owner can delete this organization.
